Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 30,240 (no earlier report in the cycle: line 3 Balance at Beginning is a handwritten '0') and is NOT summed as an increment. THE CLOSURE DECIDES THE IN-KIND QUESTION: it holds only with the two in-kind rows on p5 counted INLINE (see in_kind_convention). expenditures.anchor: the two printed 'Subtotal for this page' figures on the RETAINED Schedule B sheets — 9,689.87 (p6, 'Page 6 of 8') and 12,633.40 (p7, 'Page 7 of 8') — measured against Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (22,752) on the p2 Summary Page, re-stated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: TRACED TO A MISSING SHEET, and nothing nudged. The 17 rows on p6 sum to 9,689.87 EXACTLY = that sheet's own printed subtotal; the 17 rows on p7 sum to 12,633.40 EXACTLY = that sheet's own printed subtotal. Their total is 22,323.27, which is 428.73 SHORT of the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell of 22,752. THE DOCUMENT ITSELF NAMES THE CAUSE: the filer foliated every sheet 'of 8' — he hand-wrote 'Pg 1 of 8' on the cover and the retained sheets run 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 'of 8' — while `pdfinfo` reports Pages: 7. The eighth sheet, a third Schedule B page carrying the residual 428.73, IS ABSENT FROM THE RETAINED DOCUMENT (ADDENDUM E §E5: a filer's own foliation as evidence of missing sheets). The attribution is unique — one contiguous absent sheet — and nothing was synthesized from it: no row was invented for the 428.73 and no figure was adjusted. THE EXPENDITURE SIDE IS THEREFORE AN HONEST FLOOR: 34 rows totalling 22,323.27 of a stated 22,752. Neither Schedule B sheet's 'Total Expenditures Received' line was filled in by the filer, which is consistent with the last sheet being the one that carries it.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND, INLINE — a per-filer departure from the legacy_colAB family default, tested both ways. Two rows on p5 are in-kind: 'Taylor Audio' 250.00, which the filer himself labels by writing 'In Kind Donation' in that row's address column, and the aggregate 'Various In Kind Donations' 65.00. Both are written in the SAME Amount column as the cash rows. Monetary-only gives 29,925, which appears nowhere on the document; monetary-plus-in-kind gives 30,240, which is simultaneously the p5 subtotal chain (15,700 + 13,760 + 780), Schedule A's own printed Total Contributions Received and the cover's Column A. In-kind counted is what closes it.
